description.en-US:
Panorama NG is a fork of Panorama Tab Groups: visually group related tabs and switch between groups.

New compared to the last upstream release:
- Domain rules: map domains to groups, and matching tabs move there automatically
- Multi-tab selection: Ctrl/Cmd+click several tabs and drag them together
- A "create new group" drop target while dragging tabs
- Tiling lock: arrange groups automatically and lock them in place
- Faster view opening

Open the view with Ctrl+Alt+P. Switch groups with Alt+W and Alt+Shift+W.

Source and release notes: https://github.com/paranoidi/panorama-ng
